LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_Enabled: Pawns collect what their work drops
LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_Enabled_Desc: Pawns put the items their work drops on the ground into their inventory and bring them to storage themselves. When switched off, items already being carried are still delivered.
LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_CollectPlants_Desc: Crops, berries, wood, healroot, mushrooms, modded plants. Also when a plant is cut as part of another job, for example clearing a cell for sowing or for a building.
LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_CollectMining_Desc: Steel, components, silver, gold, plasteel, uranium, jade and other mined resources.
LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_CollectDeepDrill_Desc: The driller collects each portion. When full, it stops drilling, delivers, and can come back afterwards.
LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_CollectAnimalProducts_Des: Wool, milk and other products gathered from animals.
LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_CollectDeconstruction_Des: The materials a building or floor gives back when it is taken apart.
LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_CollectChunks_Desc: Chunks weigh so much that a single one fills most of an inventory, so they are left for the haulers by default.
LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_FillPercent: Fill inventory up to: {0} of carrying capacity
LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_FillPercent_Desc: Pawns always fill their inventory up to this limit. Once something does not fit anymore, they stop working and deliver everything, carrying the part that did not fit in their hands.
LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_MinTripMass: Stop working to deliver only with at least {0} kg collected
LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_MinTripMass_Desc: Pawns that can barely carry anything more (for example in heavy armor) still fill their inventory, but keep working instead of making a trip after every plant. They deliver when they are done with that kind of work.
LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_MaxHoldHours: Deliver after at most {0} hours of the same kind of work
LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_MaxHoldHours_Desc: While a pawn keeps doing the same kind of work (harvesting then sowing, mining cell after cell, milking one cow after another...) it carries its items along. After this many in-game hours it delivers anyway, so the colony does not wait too long for them.
LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_DeliverBeforeNeeds: Deliver before eating, sleeping or recreation
LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_DeliverBeforeNeeds_Desc: When a pawn is done with its work and heads off to eat, sleep, relax or meditate, it drops off its items first. Never applies when the pawn is urgently hungry, very tired or needs medical rest.
LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_IncludeMechanoids: Colony mechanoids collect and deliver too
LanguageData.HarvestAndHaul_IncludeMechanoids_Desc: Applies to mechanoids that can carry things, such as agrihands (Biotech).
